title: Restriction to a smaller domain does not increase mass
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U, W ⊆ ℝ^P with W ⊆ U (W need not be open), and Y ∈ D_k(U). Let Y|_W := Y.restrictDomain hWU ∈ D_k(W), so Y|_W(ω) = Y(ιω) for ω ∈ D^k(W), where ι = testFormOnInclusion hWU k regards ω as a test form on U with the same underlying differential form. Then M_W(Y|_W) ≤ M_U(Y), i.e. (Y|_W).mass ≤ Y.mass in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (hWU : W ⊆ U) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U k), (Y.restrictDomain hWU).mass ≤ Y.mass
